en.headline: Metal debris on Tolo Highway punctures more than 10 cars
en.dek: Police took reports from Saturday evening after drivers heading towards Sheung Shui hit objects near the Tai Po South exit. No one was hurt.
body: Police received a string of reports from about 8pm on Saturday after drivers on Tolo Highway towards Sheung Shui said their tyres had been punctured by metal objects near the Tai Po South exit. No injuries were reported. Traffic slowed and a queue formed while officers attended.

Drivers posting in a local traffic group said a length of what appeared to be steel reinforcement had gone through a tyre, and some tyres were split open. Other road users said more than 10 private cars had pulled onto the hard shoulder with hazard lights on between the Tai Po South entrance and the Tai Hang stretch.
Police said they were investigating what had been left on the carriageway. Motorists were advised to watch the road surface on that section of Tolo Highway.

zh.headline: 吐露港公路疑有金屬物 十多車爆胎無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚約8時起，往上水方向近大埔南出口有多輛車輪胎被硬物刺穿，現場一度出現車龍。
body: 警方周六晚上約8時起接獲多名司機報案，指駕駛沿吐露港公路往上水方向，駛至近大埔南出口時輪胎被金屬硬物刺穿。事件中無人受傷，警員到場處理期間現場一度出現車龍。
有駕駛人士在地區交通群組發帖，指座駛輪胎被疑似短鋼筋的硬物刺穿，部分車胎更裂開。亦有途經司機表示，由大埔南入口至泰亨一帶路肩停有十多輛亮起死火燈的私家車。
警方正調查路面硬物來源，並呼籲途經該路段的司機留意路面情況。
